top_signals.title: Milan Football Clubs Unveil €2.3 Billion Stadium Plan for 2031
top_signals.summary: The AC Milan SpA and FC Internazionale Milano SpA football clubs unveiled plans for a new arena to replace century-old San Siro Stadium, a redevelopment estimated to cost about €2.3 billion that will reshape one of Milan’s iconic sporting venues.
